name: Zumbro River (Green Bridge–Kellogg)

gaugeContext.note: The USGS Zumbro Falls station reports water level rather than current discharge. No suitable discharge feed is assigned; an upstream South Fork reading is not presented as the flow for these main-river trips.
gaugeContext.sourceName: USGS — Zumbro River at Zumbro Falls, station 05374000

timing.note: No reviewed flow-to-speed model or matching numeric agency trip times. Public access maps and sourced planning distances remain useful without a live estimate.

blurb: Paddle beneath southeastern Minnesota’s bluffs, from the Green Bridge and Zumbro Falls day-trip corridor to shorter outings around Theilman, Funk Ford, Kruger and Kellogg.

sections.difficulty: Lively current and riffles; snags possible
sections.notes: A DNR-recommended paddle through a bluff-lined valley below Lake Zumbro Dam. Start at Green Bridge and finish at the public Zumbro Falls access; carry-in access at the start requires moving your boat from the parking area.

notices.title: Fast-rising water and snags
notices.text: The Zumbro can rise quickly after heavy rain. Check DNR river conditions before launching and watch for downed trees and changing channels.
notices.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Zumbro River State Water Trail
